scope: Current repair campaign RL only; no teacher/ESN historical search cost or classical simulations included. Only actual rows count as physics; inherited/rebuilt rows do not. Logged optimizer updates are a lower bound if a process failed before logging or a log is missing. Rebuild updates are a subset, not an extra addend. Do not sum overlapping segment wall times as elapsed wall time. Running snapshots can differ slightly across counters. Training scores include old-reward exploration and cannot replace final-policy evaluation.
